news.headline: Crude jumps: WTI +2.4% to $85.7, Brent +1.8% to $92.3
news.what_happened: Oil rallied sharply in the latest session; Brent is back above $92. RBI has flagged the West Asia conflict and disrupted trade routes as a risk.
news.why_it_matters: Rising crude lifts upstream realisations and hurts airlines, paints and tyres through input costs.

news.headline: Gold +2.1% to $3,641, Silver +6.7% to $43.2
news.what_happened: Precious metals surged, with silver jumping nearly 7% in a session.
news.why_it_matters: Higher gold lifts gold-loan collateral values for NBFCs. It also signals some global risk-off positioning.

news.headline: Nifty closes at 25,885 (+0.25%), Sensex 84,329; IT index +3.66%
news.what_happened: Indices gained for a second session but pared early gains. HCLTech rose 6.4%, TCS 4.9% and Infosys 4.7%. Realty gained 2.8% and Metals 1.2%. Asian Paints fell 3%. FIIs bought about Rs 4,479 Cr and DIIs about Rs 4,019 Cr on Nov 25, the latest figures found.
news.why_it_matters: Markets are near 10-month highs after a sharp two-day rebound, and IT has already re-rated hard. Chasing it carries risk.

news.headline: US markets slip: S&P -0.25%, Nasdaq -0.62% (Nov 25 close)
news.what_happened: US markets were shut on Nov 26 for Thanksgiving, so the last close was Nov 25. US 10Y yield eased to 4.85%.
news.why_it_matters: Mildly soft global cue. Asia is firmer: Hang Seng +0.6%, Nikkei +1.0%.

sector_outlook.reason: Rupee flat, Nasdaq -0.6%, big rally already done
Hang Seng up, but no fresh China data

picks.logic: Upstream realisation per barrel rises directly with crude. ONGC has lagged, trading flat around Rs 222-223 while crude rallied, so a catch-up bid is plausible.
A sharp rise in gold lifts collateral values and gold-loan demand and AUM growth for Muthoot. Silver +6.7% points to strong precious-metals momentum.

risks: GIFT Nifty level could not be confirmed. If Nifty gaps up or down more than 0.5%, the watch zones shift, so wait for the open.
Nifty is near 10-month highs after a ~3% two-day rebound. A profit-booking pullback is possible, especially in IT.
Crude could reverse on geopolitical headlines. That would hit the ONGC pick.
The Nov 26 FII/DII figures were not available. The FII number used is from Nov 25.
Watch zones use the Nov 26 close from Yahoo Finance.
